title: Fit a linear mixed model — vlm_fit
text: \(\mathbf{u} \sim N(\mathbf{0}, \mathbf{G})\) \(\mathbf{e} \sim N(\mathbf{0}, \mathbf{R})\) independent, \(\mathbf{V} = \mathbf{Z}\mathbf{G}\mathbf{Z}^{\top} + \mathbf{R}\) depends covariance parameters \(\boldsymbol{\theta}\). \(P = \mathrm{rank}(\mathbf{X})\) \(N\) observations, REML log-likelihood $$\ell_R(\boldsymbol{\theta}) = -\frac{1}{2}\left\{(N - P)\log(2\pi) + \log|\mathbf{V}| + \log|\mathbf{X}^{\top}\mathbf{V}^{-1}\mathbf{X}| + \mathbf{r}^{\top}\mathbf{V}^{-1}\mathbf{r}\right\},$$ \(\mathbf{r} = \mathbf{y} - \mathbf{X}\widehat{\boldsymbol{\beta}}\); ML log-likelihood drops third term uses \(N\) first. maximised Newton steps average-information matrix \(\frac{1}{2}\mathbf{y}^{\top}\mathbf{P}\mathbf{V}_i\mathbf{P}\mathbf{V}_j\mathbf{P}\mathbf{y}\), \(\mathbf{V}_i = \partial\mathbf{V}/\partial\theta_i\) \(\mathbf{P} = \mathbf{V}^{-1} - \mathbf{V}^{-1}\mathbf{X}(\mathbf{X}^{\top}\mathbf{V}^{-1}\mathbf{X})^{-}\mathbf{X}^{\top}\mathbf{V}^{-1}\), step halving variances kept non-negative (unless bound = FALSE). fixed effects generalised least-squares solution $$\widehat{\boldsymbol{\beta}} = (\mathbf{X}^{\top}\widehat{\mathbf{V}}^{-1}\mathbf{X})^{-} \mathbf{X}^{\top}\widehat{\mathbf{V}}^{-1}\mathbf{y}$$ overparameterised coding (one column per level), generalised inverse sets aliased levels zero, SAS . Standard errors covariance parameters come observed information. Type 3 tests use sum--zero coding effect (SAS Type 3 hypothesis every cell observed). denominator degrees freedom (ddfm) : "contain", rank contribution random effects contain fixed effect, \(N - \mathrm{rank}[\mathbf{X}\ \mathbf{Z}]\) none ; "residual", \(N - \mathrm{rank}[\mathbf{X}\ \mathbf{Z}]\); "betwithin", - within-subject parts residual degrees freedom; "satterth", \(\nu = 2\{\mathbf{l}^{\top}\mathbf{C}\mathbf{l}\}^2 / \mathbf{g}^{\top}\mathbf{}\mathbf{g}\), \(\mathbf{g}\) gradient \(\mathbf{l}^{\top}\mathbf{C}\mathbf{l}\) \(\boldsymbol{\theta}\) \(\mathbf{}\) asymptotic covariance \(\widehat{\boldsymbol{\theta}}\) (Giesbrecht Burns 1985; Fai Cornelius 1996 several rows); "kr", adjusted covariance scaled F Kenward Roger (1997). "default" chooses SAS: containment random effects, -within residual structure , residual otherwise. Method "Type3" (random variance components ) equates Type 3 mean squares random effects expectations (vlm_ems()); negative solutions set zero.
